$comment: Generated from pipeline/snowlight/schemas by `uv run python -m snowlight.schemas`. Do not edit.

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

FrameCount.description: How many frames a replay has.

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

Reason.description:
The weather named for a status or a forecast.

0 winter storm, 1 ice, 2 extreme cold, 3 flooding, 4 hurricane,
5 severe storms, 6 heat, 7 power outage.
Reason.title: Reason

ReplayId.description: The storm's first local day, with a suffix when two share it.

ReplayRow.description: [school, status, first, last, reason]: the school had this status in every frame from first to last, inclusive.

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolIndex.description: A school's position in schools/meta.json ids (and in points.bin).

Status.description:
What a school is doing on a day because of weather.

0 closed, 1 delayed start, 2 remote or e-learning, 3 early dismissal.
Status.title: Status

StepMinutes.description: Minutes between one frame and the next.

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

description: replays/<id>.json: every school's statuses through one storm.

rows.description: Sorted by school, then first frame; a school's spans never overlap.

title: ReplayFile
